description: Na₄Mg(FeO₃)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.46 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.45 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.62 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.41 Å. Mg is bonded to five O atoms to form MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent FeO₅ trigonal bipyramids and edges with two equivalent FeO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.16 Å. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to five O atoms to form FeO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids and edges with two equivalent FeO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.13 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted FeO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share edges with two equivalent MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids and edges with two equivalent FeO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.89-2.14 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, and two Fe atoms to form distorted ONa₂MgFe₂ trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₃MgFe square pyramid, corners with two equivalent ONa₃MgFe trigonal bipyramids, edges with four ONa₄Fe₂ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃MgFe square pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃MgFe trigonal bipyramid. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Fe atoms to form distorted ONa₄Fe₂ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent ONa₃MgFe₂ octahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₃MgFe trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃MgFe₂ octahedra, edges with two equivalent ONa₃MgFe square pyramids, and edges with three ONa₂MgFe₂ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 11-37°. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one Fe atom to form ONa₃MgFe square pyramids that share corners with two ONa₃MgFe trigonal bipyramids, edges with four ONa₄Fe₂ octahedra, and edges with two ONa₃MgFe trigonal bipyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and two Fe atoms to form ONa₃MgFe₂ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent ONa₄Fe₂ octahedra, corners with four equivalent ONa₃MgFe trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₄Fe₂ octahedra, edges with two equivalent ONa₃MgFe square pyramids, and edges with two equivalent ONa₂MgFe₂ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 11-37°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one Fe atom to form distorted ONa₃MgFe trigonal bipyramids that share corners with six ONa₄Fe₂ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃MgFe square pyramid, corners with two equivalent ONa₂MgFe₂ trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₄Fe₂ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃MgFe square pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂MgFe₂ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 12-52°. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and two Fe atoms.
